tbesh_html:
1) to make empty, empty out
1a) (Hiphil)
1a1) to empty, keep empty or hungry
1a2) to pour out or down
1a3) to empty out
1b) (Hophal) to be emptied out

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to pour out (literally or figuratively), i.e. empty
strongs_1890.kjv_def: [idiom] arm, cast out, draw (out), (make) empty, pour forth (out).
